description: A menu of actions or links opened from a trigger button, such as an account menu or a row's More actions. Not for choosing a form value: use aihio-combobox for that.

align.description: Alignment of the dropdown content relative to the trigger

open().description: Opens the menu in the browser top layer.

aihio-before-close.description: Cancelable request fired before the menu closes.

trigger.description: The element that opens the dropdown. Must be focusable.

handled: aria-haspopup="menu" is set on the trigger
aria-expanded is toggled on the trigger
role="menu" is set on the content panel
role="menuitem" is set on each dropdown item — or, when the item's child is <a href>, on that link, which also takes the focus
Arrow keys move focus between items; Home/End jump to first/last
Typing a character moves to the next item whose label starts with it; a repeated letter cycles through the matches
A link item follows itself natively on Enter (so Ctrl/Cmd+Enter and middle-click open a new tab); Space is mapped to it
Escape closes and restores focus to the trigger
Tab and Shift+Tab close the menu and move on through the page
The Popover API provides top-layer rendering where supported; the component handles Escape and outside-pointer dismissal so close requests remain cancelable
The menu flips above the trigger and clamps to viewport edges when needed

required.requirement: Provide aria-label on the trigger (e.g. aria-label="Open menu").

counterExamples.reason: Missing slot="trigger". The dropdown has nothing to open it.
Children should be aihio-dropdown-item/separator so keyboard navigation and menuitem roles work. Put the link inside an item: Link.

related.description: A selectable item in the dropdown. Give it a single <a href> child to make it a link.

aihio-select.description: Fired when the item is selected

related.description: A visual separator between dropdown items

examples.title: An account menu with links
examples.description: An item whose child is an <a href> is a real link.
